definition: The task of assigning predefined categories or labels to a piece of text.
details: Text classification underlies many practical NLP applications, including spam detection, topic categorization, and content moderation, and can be tackled with anything from simple classical ML models to fine-tuned transformer models.
story: Think of a grammar teacher who never memorized a rule but can still tell you when a sentence sounds wrong. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It figures out meaning by noticing which words like to travel together. The machine learns to read between the lines by reading an impossible number of lines. And that is Text Classification — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
